title: Nona M NDE 959
content:
I rode a bicycle. I felt very good. Then, the first truck almost touches me. I feel the danger and a second one arrives. I feel a hit at the back of my head. I am thinking that I must not fall. But I lose my balance and I do fall. Then I feel my spine taking a second hit. At that moment, I know. I feel my nervous system is losing it. I am mad at myself over what happened as it is my fault. I first fall in a kind of waterhole with my feet forward. Then I decide to take the path towards death, with the light at the end. I think of my life and my family. My son of five years old appears. He is an angel who smiles at me. How will he be doing without his father? I have to climb up, but I cannot. A hand grabs me. I don’t see a face, yet he helps me to turn my head upwards where life is. I climb up and get out. This story of me as a cyclist of Friday 13 in the department 13 at the milestone number 13 in front of a farm that has the same name as the town where I was born shall circulate through all the neighboring villages and often leaves me thoughtful.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: “a kind of waterhole” and then “the path towards death, with the light at the end”

arrival.other_being_detail: “My son of five years old appears. He is an angel who smiles at me.” Also: “A hand grabs me. I don’t see a face” (unseen helper).

environment.environment_other_detail: “a kind of waterhole” and “the light at the end”

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Helped by an unseen hand turning her head “upwards where life is,” then she “climb[s] up and get[s] out.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Bicycle accident involving trucks; impact to back of head and spine.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Transitional “waterhole” followed by “the path towards death, with the light at the end.”
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Accident → “waterhole” → chooses “path towards death” with light → son appears as “angel” → cannot climb → unseen hand helps turn head “upwards where life is” → climbs out/returns.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Numerical coincidences emphasized: Friday 13, department 13, milestone 13, farm name same as birth town.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Then I decide to take the path towards death, with the light at the end.” “My son of five years old appears. He is an angel who smiles at me.” “A hand grabs me. I don’t see a face, yet he helps me to turn my head upwards where life is.”
